7.2: I have already revealed to you last Shabbat concerning your first two wives. Now I have come to reveal to you the secret of your third wife. You should know that this woman was in the past, a proper Torah scholar. However, he was stingy with his money and would not give charity. He was also stingy with his wisdom and would not teach others. He was therefore punished that his soul migrated into a woman, measure for measure. Therefore, his soul was incarnated into a female, who is constantly receiving and needs someone to bequeath to her. Therefore you see, that she does abundant charity and loves you very much because you work to spread Torah and toil in writing books to teach others…because these things bring about the rectification of her soul, she therefore loves you… It is because she has the soul of a male that you have not had children from her, because a male and another male cannot produce offspring. If you shall point out that she has children from her first husband, this is because the first husband has the spark of a female soul within him…

21.4: But behold, there is what to be precise about in this section: Why is, And Moses congregated, stated in this place, whereas it is not like this in the whole Torah except for the section, Congregate the people, the men, the women and the infants (Deuteronomy 31:12). But in Parashat Netzavim [HaYom Kulchem], the expression, congregation, is not mentioned. Moreover, why is, the entire community of the House of Israel, mentioned here, while it is not found like this in other places. Furthermore, He already commanded about in Parashat Terumah.
21.5: However, the hint in this thing is that the sections are in their [chronological] order. And even though it was said by the sages, may their memory be blessed, that there is no earlier or later [chronological sequence] in the Torah, there are seventy faces to [possible interpretations of] the Torah. And more strength to Moses, my chosen one [Ramban], who said that they are in their order! And they are in their order here, too. As, at first, He commanded about the work of the tabernacle in Parashat Terumah, and He said, that they shall take me a contribution from every man whose heart prompts him (Exodus 25:2). But after this, they made the calf. And as atonement for this deed, He commanded in this parashah that they themselves bring the contribution, as it is written, bring it, the contribution for the Lord (Exodus 35:5). And that which is written [right before it], Take from with you is to say everyone himself should carry the contribution of the Lord. And for that reason, the Lord congregated the entire congregation of the Children of Israel — for atonement from the liability of the calf. That is to say, that he united all of those sefirot, so that they would give light: For Moses hints to Splendor [Tiferet]; [the word,] et, Kingship [Malkhut]; entire, Foundation [Yesod]; congregation of the Children of Israel, the sefirot of the Matron; and he congregated [vayakhel, divided into its component letters], vav hints to Splendor, yod to Wisdom [Chochmah], kof [which corresponds to 100], the tally of all of the sefirot which comes to 100 — since each one is composed of ten — hey hints to Understanding [Binah] and Kingship, lamed to Understanding; and he said, is Kingship; to them [alehem divided into its component letters], alef is the three Supernal [sefirot], lamed, Understanding, hey, Understanding, mem, Understanding in the secret of the mem [setumah, the closed script that is usually only found at the end of a word, but is found in the middle of the word lemarbeh in Isaiah 9:6]; this, is Foundation; the thing, is Kingship; that, is the three Supernal ones. And because the calf was mentioned in this section — because of that, the one that worked on the day of Shabbat was punished, while he was not punished before this. As only, you shall not do any work (Exodus 20:10), was stated, and not its punishment. You shall kindle no fire in all of your settlements (Exodus 35:3): This hints to two places that each person has, one in the Garden of Eden and one in Geihinnom. And when a person lights a fire on the Shabbat day, two fires are lit and rage in those two places that we said. And that is why it calls them, all of your settlements. Bring it, the contribution for the Lord hints to the Assembly of Israel [Knesset Yisrael] becoming connected to their fathers, who are hinted in, gold, silver, and copper. And You are peace [alluding to Zohar 2:30 based on I Samuel 25:6].
